# npm projects that Positron owns, audited weekly by
# .github/workflows/dependency-audit-weekly.yml (scripts/dependency-audit.sh).
#
# One directory per line, relative to the repo root. Each directory must
# contain a package-lock.json. Upstream VS Code projects are intentionally not
# listed: we take their dependency bumps through upstream merges.
#
# When you add a new Positron extension with its own package-lock.json, add it
# here too.
